facts.fact: The Ministry of Telecommunications opened a three-day workshop in N'Djamena on 18 May 2026, with UNECA support, to lay the groundwork for Chad's first National Data Governance Strategy; participants included representatives of technology incubators and information-security specialists alongside ministry and public-entity staff, and working groups were to produce contributions for drafting the strategy.
facts.system: Stratégie Nationale de Gouvernance des Données
